description: STAND FOR CHILDREN WASHINGTON: Stand for Children, an influential non-partisan education advocacy organization, is announcing its endorsement of over two dozen legislative candidates for the upcoming November elections. Since its founding in 2007, Stand for Children Washington has always endorsed a bipartisan group of legislative candidates. This year, Stand for Children Washington split its endorsements … Continued
